value.label: Main Phase
value.description: Tank the boss near an arena edge so Lapidating Bash sends its T-shaped Black Gem Clusters toward the edge instead of through the middle.

evidence.source_name: AlcastHQ Black Gem Foundry Dungeon Guide

value.label: Lava Phase I
value.description: Boss leaves the arena, lava closes space, and a Soulbinder Pyromancer appears. Kill the Pyromancer first and stack other adds onto it for cleave.

evidence.source_name: AlcastHQ Black Gem Foundry Dungeon Guide

value.label: Lava Phase II
value.description: Repeat the Pyromancer priority and flame-wall handling; prepare to stack for the shard/beam sequence when the boss returns.

evidence.source_name: AlcastHQ Black Gem Foundry Dungeon Guide

value.label: Execute / Heating Pattern
value.description: Boss stays active while alternating unusable edge or center floor patterns; continue Transference and Soul Focus handling without the earlier full disappearance phase.
